<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Enrolls the remaining LM Eval jobs in `automatic_shard`: 30 jobs (16 steps and 14 AMD mirrors). Part of a series that enrolls every remaining test step, split by test area for review. No commands change.

## Claims

| Step | Plan | AMD mirror |
|---|---|---|
| `kv-offload-large` | 2 shards | 1 shard |
| `gpqa-eval-gpt-oss-2xb200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `lm-eval-turboquant-k8v4` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `kv-offload-small` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `lm-eval-humming-h100-deepep` | 1 shard | none |
| `kv-offload-medium` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `lm-eval-dspark-watermark-2xh100` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `lm-eval-nemotron-3-super-8xh200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `gpqa-eval-gpt-oss-spark` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `mrcr-eval-small-models` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `lm-eval-watermarking` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `amd-lm-eval-large-models-rocm-harness` | 1 shard | none |
| `amd-lm-eval-large-models` | 1 shard | none |
| `amd-lm-eval-large-models-harness` | 1 shard | none |
| `amd-lm-eval-octave-mi300` | 1 shard | none |
| `amd-lm-eval-small-models-harness` | 1 shard | none |
| `lm-eval-small-models` | already enrolled | 1 shard |
| `moe-refactor-integration-test-h100-temporary` | already enrolled | 1 shard |
| `moe-refactor-integration-test-b200-temporary` | already enrolled | 1 shard |
| `moe-refactor-integration-test-b200-dp-temporary` | already enrolled | 1 shard |

- One-shard and one-job plans run the same tests as on main, as one job, and split by themselves once their tests grow.
- Plans of 2 or more shards cost one extra job setup per shard and bring each shard under the 20-minute target.

## Validation

- Planned each step and mirror with ci-infra main's planner against main's timings; every plan is within 10% of the same plan run as one job.
- The sharding harness (each shard's commands run against a mock test tree, as a PR build and as main with the OTel wrapper) shows every test runs exactly once wherever a plan has 2 or more shards.
- Every step and mirror passes on recent main runs, nightly included.
- `/ci run` (98455) plus a scoped build (98466) for the optional steps and AMD mirrors on this head: every enrolled job passed, and every shard finished under 22 minutes.

## Details

- **Not plain pytest** steps (shell scripts, `torchrun`, examples) are enrolled too; the generator keeps them as one job. Standalone AMD steps plan like any other since vllm-project/ci-infra#871.
- **caplog.** Files that assert on logs sit in one-shard plans here, so their order in the process doesn't change.
- **KV-Offload Large** splits its one file by test into 2 shards: the wait drops from about 30 to 18 minutes, for about 16% more machine time because each shard loads its model. Kept for the shorter wait, as with Multimodal Extended Pooling.
- **Timeouts unchanged.** `timeout_in_minutes` stays per job. Fallback-aware timeouts belong in a central timeout setting.
